items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Jim Harrison took it from there.

ctx.x: What are some of the other highlights of your career?

- - - Playing for jazzmobile. Yeah, they hire me every year just about. Jim Harrison. Well Billy Taylor is really the one that -- Jim Harrison took it from there. And Gil Anderson [Gail] Anderson ... and they hire me because I generally put a pretty good show on. I played in my own block for two years. They keep requesting it

so they give it to 'em. But I have played all over, all around 5th Avenue, 126th, 24th, but I've been playin' with Jazzmobile, that was one of the big things. And I'd have to say the festival was another.
